Alien conspiracy theories are somehow even weirder than I remembered.

Today we're diving into some of the biggest alien conspiracy theories ever, from Roswell and Area 51 to the Face on Mars, the Tic Tac UFO, Saturn's mysterious hexagon, reptilian celebrities, and everything in between. I wanted to see just how deep the alien rabbit hole goes, and honestly... I might want to believe.
